Yesterday I started looking at the details of the code, and didn't really thing about the big picture here. I should have started with that sorry.

To sum up your current approach:
1. a public callback is added to the server object to notify about lease changes
2. networkd gets a public api to expose leases as a dbus property
3. networkd installs a callback and sends out notifications when this property changes
4. networkctl reads the property and uses that to dump current leases.

Part 3 seems dubious. Exporting the property seems OK, but is this really something that we should send out notifications for? And if notifications are not needed, then 1. becomes unnecessary too. (In the sense that networkd could simply generate that list when requested, but not monitor changes.)

Another problem is the include of `dhcp-server-internal.h` from `src/network/`. So far, networkd was not using the internal APIs of the DHCP server. This *could* be done, but OTOH, it seems that the lease list is something that should be exposed by the server using a public API. So I would prefer to make add an "sd_" function that cleanly exposes that list, and make use of that in src/network/.

issue_context.title: RFE: provide DHCP server details
issue_context.body:
It would be useful to provide the per-link DHCP server details. I guess it should be introspected over dbus, and networkctl status could provide some basic informations.

fwiw, dnsmasq has a dbus interface
```
[root@boraha systemd]# busctl introspect uk.org.thekelleys.dnsmasq /uk/org/thekelleys/dnsmasq 
NAME                                TYPE      SIGNATURE RESULT/VALUE FLAGS
org.freedesktop.DBus.Introspectable interface -         -            -
.Introspect                         method    -         s            -
uk.org.thekelleys.dnsmasq           interface -         -            -
.AddDhcpLease                       method    ssayayuub -            -
.ClearCache                         method    -         -            -
.DeleteDhcpLease                    method    s         b            -
.GetLoopServers                     method    -         as           -
.GetMetrics                         method    -         a{su}        -
.GetVersion                         method    -         s            -
.SetBogusPrivOption                 method    b         -            -
.SetDomainServers                   method    as        -            -
.SetFilterWin2KOption               method    b         -            -
.SetServers                         method    av        -            -
.SetServersEx                       method    aas       -            -
.DhcpLeaseAdded                     signal    sss       -            -
.DhcpLeaseDeleted                   signal    sss       -            -
.DhcpLeaseUpdated                   signal    sss       -            -
```
https://github.com/imp/dnsmasq/blob/master/dbus/DBus-interface


Is it reasonable to add a new interface over the existing networkd link paths?
On `/org/freedesktop/network1/link/_36`, add `org.freedesktop.network1.DHCPServer` ?

It would have a `Leases` property, of type: `a(ayayayayt)`: array of
```
ay client_id
ay address
ay gateway
ay hwaddr
t expiration
```
